text:
Ravi: FYI a customer (T-77) backfill is sitting RUNNING but aggregate counts unchanged for 5h. Billing spiked and they pinged CS.
Tess: job id?
Ravi: backfill-2026-03-t77-aggpass. Processed 1.1M rows but `aggregates_emitted` stayed flat.
Maya: suspicious. We recently landed the KV-format migration for EU shards. If readers hit old-format keys they'll NACK and requeue.
Ben (ops): ops logs show repeated `kv_schema_mismatch` errors then pause -> heartbeat. Snip: ```
[2026-03-19T02:22:11Z] read_batch=1024
[2026-03-19T02:22:11Z] kv_schema_mismatch=true
[2026-03-19T02:22:11Z] backoff_ms=12000
[2026-03-19T02:22:11Z] heartbeat_only=true
```
Ivy: Console only shows job state/progress % and tokens billed. We need a quick signal to tell SREs this is a KV-schema issue vs quota/backpressure.
Maya: propose adding `job_wait_signal` enum (values: QUOTA, KV_SCHEMA, SHARD_LOCK, DEPENDENCY) and `job_wait_count` counter. That should be cheap.
Tess: also add `kv_mismatch_count` and the top-3 offending shard ids in the job metadata so ops can target a shard-level fix.
Ravi: for billing clarity we need `tokens_effective_processed` separate from `tokens_billed_heartbeats`. Billing-bot can ignore heartbeats.
billing-bot: noted. Please emit metric `billing/processed_tokens` and tag `heartbeat=true|false`.
console-team: UI ask: can we show a compact "Wait Reason" chip in the job list and expose a quick action: "retry shard" which triggers a targeted retry job for specified shard ids?
Ben (ops): targeted retry helps. But retrying across schema mismatch will just keep failing. We need an operator action: "force-compat-translate" that runs a transient translator job on the shard (requires owner opt-in).
Ivy: security policy: any force-translate or preemptive translation needs tenant-owner email and audit log entry. We should present a modal with owner email and reason.
Maya: implementation note: workloops already surface backpressure flags. I can plumb `job_wait_signal` through the runtime and annotate the job envelope within 3 hours.
Ravi: console-team, what's minimal to land this quickly?
console-team: minimal: read `job_wait_signal` label and show chip + link to job detail. Prototype in 2 working days, can ship in next deploy. Full retry UI + modal takes PTO-sized cycle (1 sprint).
Ben (ops): add an alert: job RUNNING && job_wait_signal != "" && job_wait_since > 15m -> alert #eng-platform oncall. Use severity low unless tenant priority tag is high.
Tess: also avoid billing surprises: when `heartbeat_only=true` tag present, dashboard should not include those tokens in daily burn. I'll add a filter in the cost pipeline.
billing-bot: pulling a pull request template for excluding heartbeat tokens: https://redwood.internal/pulls/heartbeat-billing-exclude (autogenerated comment).
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: maya/job-wait-signal -> staging. CI: 4/4 green.
Ravi: decision summary: (1) Maya emits `job_wait_signal`, `kv_mismatch_count`, `tokens_effective_processed` (ETA 3h) (2) console-team implements Wait Reason chip minimal view (ETA 2 days) (3) ops adds alert rule and owner-approval flow spec for force-translate (ETA today for alert rule) (4) billing pipeline filters heartbeat-tagged tokens (ops/billing)
Ivy: I'll draft the small docs blurb and tenant-owner modal copy. Add to runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/backfills/ops-runbook :memo:
Tess: thanks all — ping this thread when staging deploy is up so ops can rehearse with a synthetic job.
